observed: Expired recent authentication during encrypted export showed generic Start Here action not completed with Refresh and review/OK, instead of the required login action. After that alert remained open past30seconds, dismissing it left no login prompt.
cause: NativeReauthenticationPrompt waits at most30seconds behind other UIAlertControllers; StartHerePreviewStore published a failed state for the same403 and created a competing SwiftUI alert.
fix: Recognize exact403reauthentication_required and preserve the previous operation/preview state, leaving recovery to the shared prompt and requiring explicit retry. Other errors remain failures.

afterTests.simulator: isolated existing QA worker; Owner session not used
